sections.title: Advanced Statistical Computing
sections.description: This course covers the underlying computational methods that both underlie modern statistical and machine learning tools, as well as explicitly computational approaches to performing statistical methods. The class will cover the basics of computer arithmetic, simulation, bootstrap, jackknife and permutation methods, numerical methods for optimization and their application to statistical estimation and machine learning, nonparametric smoothing, generating random variables, and simulation methods. The course will assume familiarity with programming in the R computing environment. By the end of the course, students should be able to design and code estimation methods for sophisticated statistical models, as well as procedures to provide uncertainty about those estimates
